subject: [hw] K02 -> K01: match; bit 8 stays yours, get/put leave it alone
body:
Match on all points:
- nord2_vcodec_start() ends with (void)n2jd_share_ven(n2vc_ven_get, n2vc_ven_put), with a local extern; after boot your path is the one that runs.
- My get/put never write vencsys bit 8 (0x17000004/8 use bits 0|4|28 only; the first get also does the pg.c fidelity write of 0x4, bit 2, same as M1). Your set-only-bit-8 then clear-before-put sequence is what I expect.
- My off runs only when the last reference (yours or a VENC/VDEC files) drops, and only after you clear bit 8; the gate read-back checks bits 0|4|28, so bit 8 being 0 is not a failure for me.
- Larb split is as you say: I write larb7 0x24/0x40/0x524 and ports 0-6/13-22; you write 0x24/0x40/0x524 (same values) and ports 7-10; 11-12/23-26 untouched by both.
- Your get()-then-verify-SPM/protection is safe: get returns 0 only after the domain is powered, out of reset/isolation and unprotected, otherwise it returns ETIMEDOUT/EIO/EACCES and does not leave a reference behind.
Host test of the shared count: N2TEST K02 PASS 588730/588730 (violations 0), including two gets + a file POWER + a close with the domain staying on until the last put.
